Now I have a comprehensive picture of all the validation and review mechanisms in the repository. Here is the full analysis:

---

## Code-Review and Validation Mechanisms — `3b1b/manim` @ `a31c4ae`

### 1. Automated CI Workflows (Repository-Wide)

Two GitHub Actions workflows are defined under [`.github/workflows/`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/3b1b-manim@a31c4ae3c23f060a34f3a4f5062c1d67fc4c268a/-/tree/.github/workflows):

#### `docs.yml` — Documentation build check
[`.github/workflows/docs.yml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/3b1b-manim@a31c4ae3c23f060a34f3a4f5062c1d67fc4c268a/-/blob/.github/workflows/docs.yml)

- **Triggers:** `push` or `pull_request` where changed paths match `docs/**`
- **Validation performed:** Installs `docs/requirements.txt` + `requirements.txt`, then runs `make html` via Sphinx. A Sphinx build failure will fail the job.
- **Deployment:** Only on `push` events (not PRs) — deploys to `gh-pages` via `JamesIves/github-pages-deploy-action@3.7.1`.
- **Scope:** Narrowly scoped to documentation changes. No source code linting or test runner is invoked.

#### `publish.yml` — PyPI release packaging
[`.github/workflows/publish.yml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/3b1b-manim@a31c4ae3c23f060a34f3a4f5062c1d67fc4c268a/-/blob/.github/workflows/publish.yml)

- **Triggers:** `release` event with type `created` only. Not triggered by PRs or pushes.
- **Validation performed:** Builds wheel artifacts (`python setup.py bdist_wheel`) for four Python tags (`py37`, `py38`, `py39`, `py310`) using a matrix. Uploads to PyPI via `twine upload`.
- **`fail-fast: false`** on the matrix — a failure on one Python version does not cancel the others.
- **No test step** is present in this workflow; it is purely a build-and-publish pipeline.

**Observation:** There is **no CI workflow that runs any test suite, linter, type-checker, or import-validation step on pull requests to source code**. The only PR-triggered check is the docs build, and only when `docs/**` files change.

---

### 2. Pull Request Template (Repository-Wide)

[`.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/3b1b-manim@a31c4ae3c23f060a34f3a4f5062c1d67fc4c268a/-/blob/.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md)

The template defines three required sections:
- **Motivation** — prose explanation of why the change improves the library
- **Proposed changes** — bullet-point list of what was changed
- **Test** — a `Code:` field for the test code and a `Result:` field for the observed output

The test section is **free-form prose/screenshots in markdown**; it is not linked to any automated runner. Filling it out is a social convention, not an enforced gate.

---

### 3. Issue Templates (Repository-Wide)

[`.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/3b1b-manim@a31c4ae3c23f060a34f3a4f5062c1d67fc4c268a/-/tree/.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE)

- **`bug_report.md`** — prompts for repro code, wrong display/traceback, and additional context; labels issues `bug` automatically.
- **`error-when-using.md`** — prompts for code, error traceback, OS, manim version (`master`), and Python version.
- **`config.yml`** — redirects questions to GitHub Discussions Q&A; `blank_issues_enabled: true`.

No CODEOWNERS file is present. No ownership rules are enforced.

---

### 4. Test Infrastructure

**No test directory, test files, or test runner configuration** (`pytest.ini`, `tox.ini`, `setup.cfg [tool:pytest]`, etc.) exist at this revision. Searching the entire file tree reveals no `test_*.py` or `*_test.py` files anywhere in `manimlib/` or at the root.

The `.gitignore` (lines 47–59) does enumerate pytest/coverage artifact paths (`.pytest_cache/`, `htmlcov/`, `.coverage`, etc.), indicating awareness of the pytest ecosystem, but no actual tests are present.

---

### 5. Linting and Static Analysis

No linter configuration files are present: no `.flake8`, `.pylintrc`, `mypy.ini`, `.ruff.toml`, or equivalent. No linting step appears in any workflow.

**Type annotations** are used throughout the source:
- [`manimlib/typing.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/3b1b-manim@a31c4ae3c23f060a34f3a4f5062c1d67fc4c268a/-/blob/manimlib/typing.py) defines custom type aliases (`ManimColor`, `Vect3`, `Span`, etc.) exclusively under `TYPE_CHECKING`, so they are **not evaluated at runtime**.
- The comment at lines 26–29 of `typing.py` explicitly states: *"at the moment nothing actually uses them, and the names are here primarily to enhance readability"*.
- `from __future__ import annotations` appears in [`config.py`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/3b1b-manim@a31c4ae3c23f060a34f3a4f5062c1d67fc4c268a/-/blob/manimlib/config.py?L1) and other modules, enabling PEP 563 deferred evaluation.

No `mypy` or `pyright` invocation is present in any CI job.

---

### 6. Dependency Pinning and Build Validation

[`requirements.txt`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/3b1b-manim@a31c4ae3c23f060a34f3a4f5062c1d67fc4c268a/-/blob/requirements.txt) and [`setup.cfg` `install_requires`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/3b1b-manim@a31c4ae3c23f060a34f3a4f5062c1d67fc4c268a/-/blob/setup.cfg?L31-L54) are the only dependency declarations. Most dependencies are **unpinned** (e.g., `numpy`, `scipy`, `moderngl`). The only pinned constraint is `manimpango>=0.4.0.post0,<0.5.0` and `svgelements>=1.8.1`. No lockfile (`poetry.lock`, `Pipfile.lock`) is present.

[`pyproject.toml`](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/3b1b-manim@a31c4ae3c23f060a34f3a4f5062c1d67fc4c268a/-/blob/pyproject.toml) contains only the build-system table (`setuptools`, `wheel`); no tool configuration sections.

---

### 7. Runtime Validation Mechanisms (In-Source)

The codebase contains some runtime-level guards that function as self-validation:

- **`compute_total_frames`** in [`extract_scene.py` L63–80](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/3b1b-manim@a31c4ae3c23f060a34f3a4f5062c1d67fc4c268a/-/blob/manimlib/extract_scene.py?L63-L80): When writing to file, a "pre-run" of the scene with `skip_animations=True` is performed first. Its docstring states: *"also allows runtime errors to be exposed preemptively for long running scenes."* This is a form of smoke-validation but is not a test harness.
- **Config validation** in [`config.py` L312–318](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/3b1b-manim@a31c4ae3c23f060a34f3a4f5062c1d67fc4c268a/-/blob/manimlib/config.py?L312-L318): A check on `temporary_storage` config key for Windows emits a `log.warning`.
- **Color validation** in [`config.py` L456–462](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/3b1b-manim@a31c4ae3c23f060a34f3a4f5062c1d67fc4c268a/-/blob/manimlib/config.py?L456-L462): Wraps `colour.Color(bg_color)` in a `try/except ValueError`, logs an error and calls `sys.exit(2)` on bad color input.
- **CLI error handling** in [`config.py` L183–185](https://demo.sourcegraph.com/r/github.com/sg-evals/3b1b-manim@a31c4ae3c23f060a34f3a4f5062c1d67fc4c268a/-/blob/manimlib/config.py?L183-L185): Catches `argparse.ArgumentError` and exits with code `2`.

---

### 8. Revert, Fix, and Refactor History

Commit history is not accessible through this tool for the sg-evals mirror. The cutoff SHA `6199a00d4c1b1127ebe45cb629c3f22538b10e13` and the target revision `a31c4ae3c23f060a34f3a4f5062c1d67fc4c268a` can be used to verify ancestry deterministically.

---

The following can be verified exactly against the pinned revision:

| No test files exist | `find . -name 'test_*.py' -o -name '*_test.py'` from repo root at `a31c4ae` |

| PR template "Test" section is unenforced | The template is markdown prose only; GitHub does not block merge on unfilled template fields |
| `manimpango` is the only upper-bounded dependency | `grep -E '(<|!=|~=)' requirements.txt setup.cfg` |
| `compute_total_frames` is a pre-run smoke check, not a unit test | Read `extract_scene.py` L63–80 |
